**(a) Social posts**

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must act now to prevent that future.

2. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We are working for a ban because the stakes are that stark.

3. We cannot treat the prospect of superintelligent AI as business as usual. Built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop it.

**(b) Newsletter opening (106 words)**

We believe the choice before us is stark: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not a distant or abstract concern. The decisions made now about AI development and policy will shape whether that future arrives. At the Institute for Long-Term Intelligence Policy, we work to build public understanding and political support for a ban on superintelligence. We cannot make this technology safe by moving faster or hoping for the best. We must prevent its creation. In this newsletter, we share the arguments, policy work, and communications efforts we believe can help avert catastrophe.
